ios.desc:
Awesome Breathing is a simple, elegant tool to guide and visualize your breathing. Use it daily to help with meditation, sleep, stress, anxiety, focus, or to simply bring a few moments of calm and mindfulness to your day.

The perfect breathwork app. Simple, unobtrusive, and best of all, free to use anytime! Set your own pace, follow the calming animated pacer, and enjoy guided breathing exercises for relaxation, stress and anxiety relief, better sleep, and focus.

Don't take our word for it:

** 4.9 stars, over 3,700 ratings **

"Two thumbs up, three if I had them. Works exactly as advertised and is super easy to use. Free to use if you want! I happily sent them support and could choose my own amount. As they say in the app name, AWESOME!"

"Beautiful and responsive UI with customizable breathing patterns."

"I have tested at least a dozen breathing apps. This one is BY FAR the best one I've used. Simple layout, real voice cues, custom programs, and a menu that is relaxing and intuitive. Get it!"

"Excellent app, simple to use. As a psychotherapist I am using it myself and recommending it to clients who might benefit."

Features:

• Clean, simple interface for an uncluttered and calming breathing experience
• Fully customizable inhale, exhale, and optional hold (pause) durations, so you can build any breathing exercise or technique you like
• Choose from fifteen included programs, such as Box Breathing, Relaxing Breathing (4-7-8), Equal Breathing, Measured Breathing, and Triangle Breathing, plus patterns for focus, running, and performance
• Create and save your own custom breathing programs
• Sessions can be free-form (no set duration) or timed, by duration or by number of breaths
• Optional pre-session countdown timer gives you a few moments to settle in before your session begins
• Choose from several beautiful pacer color themes
• Ambient background soundscapes to relax and breathe along to
• Optional guided voice and tone cues signal when to inhale, hold, and exhale, so you can breathe with your eyes closed and without looking at your device, each with its own volume
• Start and end bells can be enabled to signal the beginning and end of your sessions
• Vibration mode allows for silent, eyes closed breathing sessions
• Playback continues when your screen is locked or the app is in the background, so your cues never stop
• Save your sessions as Mindful Minutes in the Apple Health app
